data.narrative:
Canada Rocket Company is a seed-stage Space & Aerospace venture that has raised $6.2M to date. The Space & Aerospace sector contains a modest but established comp universe: 5 public peers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX and Rocket Lab.

Valuation analysis is constrained by data limitations. Stage-Progression is the sole applicable method, applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement to the $6.2M total raised proxy, yielding $15.5M. Peer-Median analysis is not reliable: while 14 same-sector peers exist, none satisfy narrow filters (same-stage, adjacent-stage, similar-tier), and a broader cross-sector median would introduce material bias. Public-Comp Anchoring cannot be deployed—the 5 public Space & Aerospace comps trade at a 27.4x median P/S, but Canada Rocket Company's revenue is not disclosed, precluding P/S application.

Given single-method triangulation, the analysis supports a valuation range of $13M (low) to $18M (high), with a median point of $16M. This range reflects routine seed-stage progression but carries outsized uncertainty: the absence of same-stage private comparables and undisclosed revenue leave material blind spots regarding cash burn, technical milestones, and competitive positioning. A credible valuation refinement would require either disclosed revenue data or a larger set of comparable seed-stage aerospace ventures.
